bow.description: A formal bow, standing start and end

idle.description: Calm standing with breath and weight shift (a held pose from the bow with the head turned to the front, animated by code)

walk.description: Walk cycle, one stride starting on the left heel strike

run.description: Run cycle, one stride starting on the left heel strike

jump.description: Standing jump: crouch, take off, land, recover

getup.description: Getting up from lying face down

punch.description: A straight punch with the left hand and back to guard

wave.description: Waving hello with the right arm (play on an upper-body layer to walk and wave)
